text: The Dassam Falls (also known as Dassam Ghagh) is a waterfall located near Taimara village in the Bundu subdivision of Ranchi district in the Indian state of Jharkhand. The Falls are 144 feet in height, formed by the waterflow of the Kanchi River.
best_time: October to March (pleasant weather, ideal for heritage monuments, wildlife, and cultural walks)
